chunks: So do not allow Satan to have a share in you, nor a way to dominate over your self; and peace.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali mean by not letting Satan have a 'share' or 'way' over oneself?
ai.summary: In this concise yet profound response to Muawiya, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) utilizes the metaphor of 'nasib' (share/portion) to warn against allowing Satan to establish a permanent foothold within the self. This exhortation underscores the Shia concept of active spiritual vigilance, where the individual must prevent the devil from carving out a 'sabil' (path or way) to dominate their will and actions.
